ModMetaData.name: Boomsnake Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces VanillaExpanded.VGeneticsE's GR_Boomsnake art (all three lifeStages share one texPath) with custom generated Pyrelands-themed art (pyrelands_boomsnake_v2). The dessicated-corpse texture (Dessicated_Boomsnake) stays on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Reptile/Boomsnake/Boomsnake_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
